en.title: Bruins look to reset at home against a Chicago team still winless on the road
en.deck: Boston leads the Atlantic at 9-4-1 but comes home from two road losses that ended an eight-game point streak. Chicago is the only team without a road win this season and has scored two goals or fewer in five straight games. The model makes the Bruins clear favourites, a little less clearly than the market.
news: Boston lost 2-1 at Carolina and 4-1 at St. Louis this week, even though it outshot the Blues 32-18. Coach Marco Sturm called recent play sloppy and hopes the losses work as a wake-up call.
Twelve of the Bruins' next 14 games are at TD Garden. David Pastrnak leads the team with 7 goals and 18 points.
Chicago lost 4-1 in Detroit on Thursday, with Connor Bedard scoring the only goal. Coach Jeff Blashill called it a step backwards.
The Blackhawks have lost Ryan Ellis for the season with a back injury. Neither starting goalie had been confirmed on Friday.
records: Chicago is 0-5-0 on the road, the only NHL team without an away win.
The Blackhawks have scored 1.2 goals a game over their last five and have lost four of them.
Bedard, who started the season hurt, has 3 goals and 7 points in 7 games. Rookies James Hagens and Fraser Minten have 5 goals each for Boston.
Morgan Geekie has gone nine games without a goal, and the model flags him as due.

sv.deck: Boston toppar Atlanten med 9-4-1 men kommer hem efter två bortaförluster som bröt en svit på åtta matcher med poäng. Chicago är enda laget utan bortaseger i år och har gjort högst två mål i fem raka matcher. Modellen har Bruins som klara favoriter, men lite mindre klara än marknaden.
news: Boston föll med 2-1 i Carolina och 4-1 i St. Louis i veckan, trots 32-18 i skott mot Blues. Tränaren Marco Sturm kallade spelet slarvigt och hoppas att förlusterna blir en väckarklocka.
Tolv av Bruins nästa 14 matcher spelas i TD Garden. David Pastrnak leder laget med 7 mål och 18 poäng.
Chicago förlorade med 4-1 i Detroit i torsdags, där Connor Bedard gjorde lagets enda mål. Tränaren Jeff Blashill kallade det ett steg bakåt.
Blackhawks har förlorat Ryan Ellis för säsongen med en ryggskada. Ingen av startmålvakterna var bekräftad i fredags.

en.title: Red Wings move on without Larkin as Arvidsson keeps scoring
en.deck: Detroit has won five of its last seven and Viktor Arvidsson comes in off a hat trick, but the week has been about Dylan Larkin, who asked for a trade, lost the captaincy and was suspended without pay. St. Louis opens a four-game trip after beating Boston 4-1. The market sees a coin flip; the model leans slightly to Detroit.
news: Larkin says he will not play until he is traded. Interim GM Shawn Horcoff suspended him, and coach Todd McLellan says the team is moving on.
John Gibson starts for Detroit. Marco Kasper and Mason Appleton are out with upper-body injuries, about 10 days away.
St. Louis: Robert Thomas and Philip Broberg each had a goal and two assists against Boston, and Joel Hofer made 31 saves. Colton Parayko missed Friday's practice but is considered probable.
Justin Faulk faces the Blues for the first time since they traded him to Detroit in March.
records: Arvidsson's hat trick on Thursday was his first for Detroit and gives him hat tricks with four franchises. He leads the team with 8 goals and has 17 points in 28 career games against St. Louis.
Detroit is 5-1-3 in its last nine and swept last season's series, outscoring the Blues 11-6.
Jimmy Snuggerud has 7 goals, and the model flags his finishing as running hot.
The last six meetings averaged 6.8 goals.
betting: Market: 1.92 on both teams, a 50–50 split. The model has Detroit 54–46.

sv.title: Red Wings går vidare utan Larkin medan Arvidsson fortsätter att göra mål
sv.deck: Detroit har vunnit fem av sju och Viktor Arvidsson kommer från ett hattrick, men veckan har handlat om Dylan Larkin, som bett om en trade, fråntagits kaptensbindeln och stängts av utan lön. St. Louis inleder en bortaresa på fyra matcher efter 4-1 mot Boston. Marknaden ser en slantsingling, modellen lutar lite åt Detroit.
news: Larkin säger att han inte spelar förrän han tradats. Tillförordnade GM:en Shawn Horcoff stängde av honom, och tränaren Todd McLellan säger att laget går vidare.
John Gibson startar för Detroit. Marco Kasper och Mason Appleton är borta med överkroppsskador i ungefär tio dagar till.
St. Louis: Robert Thomas och Philip Broberg gjorde ett mål och två assist var mot Boston, och Joel Hofer räddade 31 skott. Colton Parayko missade fredagens träning men väntas spela.
Justin Faulk möter Blues för första gången sedan de tradade honom till Detroit i mars.

Detroit har 5-1-3 de senaste nio och vann alla möten förra säsongen med 11-6 i mål.

en.title: Kucherov's trade request follows the Lightning to Stamkos and Nashville
en.deck: Nikita Kucherov has told Tampa Bay he will not re-sign and wants a trade, AP reported Friday, a week after he passed Steven Stamkos as the franchise's all-time points leader. Now the Lightning visit Stamkos and a Nashville team that already has five losses after regulation. Both the model and the market favour Tampa.
news: The trade request is based on anonymous sources, and GM Julien BriseBois did not comment. Kucherov, 33, is in the last year of his contract and is still projected on the top line with Jake Guentzel and Brayden Point.
Tampa beat Winnipeg 6-4 on Thursday, when Anthony Cirelli earned his 200th NHL assist. Zemgus Girgensons and Yanni Gourde are out.
Nashville lost 4-3 to Washington on Thursday despite two goals from Filip Forsberg. Coach Andrew Brunette said his team got nothing out of the game.
NHL.com projects Andrei Vasilevskiy against Juuse Saros. This is the teams' first meeting of the season.
records: Tampa has a power-play goal in five straight games (5 for 16) and is 6-0-0 at home.
Nashville leads the league with five losses in overtime or shootouts and is 1-2-2 in its last five.
Forsberg has a power-play goal in three straight games and 7 points in that span. Stamkos and Ryan O'Reilly share the team lead with 7 goals.
Eight of Tampa's 12 games have gone over 5.5 goals.

sv.title: Kucherovs tradebegäran följer med Lightning till Stamkos och Nashville
sv.deck: Nikita Kucherov har sagt till Tampa Bay att han inte förlänger och vill bli tradad, rapporterade AP i fredags, en vecka efter att han passerat Steven Stamkos som klubbens främste poänggörare genom tiderna. Nu möter Lightning Stamkos och ett Nashville som redan har fem förluster efter full tid. Både modellen och marknaden har Tampa som favorit.
news: Uppgiften om tradebegäran bygger på anonyma källor, och GM:en Julien BriseBois kommenterade inte. Kucherov, 33, spelar sista året på kontraktet och står fortfarande i förstakedjan med Jake Guentzel och Brayden Point.
Tampa slog Winnipeg med 6-4 i torsdags, då Anthony Cirelli noterades för sin 200:e assist i NHL. Zemgus Girgensons och Yanni Gourde är borta.
Nashville förlorade med 4-3 mot Washington i torsdags trots två mål av Filip Forsberg. Tränaren Andrew Brunette sa att laget inte fick ut något av matchen.
NHL.com räknar med Andrei Vasilevskiy mot Juuse Saros. Det är lagens första möte för säsongen.

Forsberg har gjort powerplaymål i tre raka matcher och har 7 poäng på dem. Stamkos och Ryan O'Reilly delar lagets skytteliga med 7 mål.

en.title: McDavid's record assist run meets Schaefer and Sorokin
en.deck: Connor McDavid has an assist in all 13 games, the longest such start to a season in NHL history, and leads the league with 36 points. The Islanders come home after Matthew Schaefer won it in overtime in Minnesota. The market favours Edmonton; the model has this almost even.
news: Mike Babcock, in his first season behind Edmonton's bench, has made Trent Frederic and Jake Walman healthy scratches. Tristan Jarry starts after his 24-save shutout of Calgary on Wednesday.
Zach Hyman (neck) is on injured reserve. Jason Dickinson is back after missing six games.
Islanders: Ryan Pulock (upper body) left Thursday's game after two shifts. Mathew Barzal and Alexander Romanov are also out, and Ilya Sorokin is the projected starter.
Schaefer scored twice in Thursday's 4-3 overtime win, and earlier in the week he played 32:16, the most ever by a teenager in one game.
records: McDavid's 28 assists in October make it his second career 25-assist month. Only Wayne Gretzky and Mario Lemieux have done it more than once.
Edmonton has the league's best power play (35.7%) and scores the most (4.23 goals a game), but its penalty kill ranks 25th.
Schaefer's five multi-goal games tie Phil Housley's record for a teenage defenseman.
Nine of Edmonton's 13 games have gone over 5.5, but the last six meetings averaged only 4.3 goals.
betting: Market: Oilers 1.73, Islanders 2.15, about 55–45 Edmonton without the margin. The model has it 52–48 for the Islanders, one of the bigger gaps of the day.

sv.title: McDavids rekordsvit med assist möter Schaefer och Sorokin
sv.deck: Connor McDavid har en assist i samtliga 13 matcher, den längsta sådana säsongsinledningen i NHL:s historia, och leder ligan med 36 poäng. Islanders kommer hem efter att Matthew Schaefer avgjort på förlängning i Minnesota. Marknaden har Edmonton som favorit, modellen ser en jämn match.
news: Mike Babcock, som har sin första säsong som Edmontons tränare, har petat Trent Frederic och Jake Walman. Tristan Jarry startar efter nollan med 24 räddningar mot Calgary i onsdags.
Zach Hyman (nacke) är skadad. Jason Dickinson är tillbaka efter sex missade matcher.
Islanders: Ryan Pulock (överkropp) lämnade torsdagens match efter två byten. Mathew Barzal och Alexander Romanov är också borta, och Ilya Sorokin väntas starta.
Schaefer gjorde två mål i torsdagens 4-3-seger på förlängning, och tidigare i veckan spelade han 32.16, mest någonsin för en tonåring i en match.
records: McDavids 28 assist i oktober är hans andra månad i karriären med minst 25 assist. Bara Wayne Gretzky och Mario Lemieux har gjort det fler gånger.
Edmonton har ligans bästa powerplay (35,7 %) och gör flest mål (4,23 per match), men boxplayet är 25:e bäst.
Schaefers fem matcher med flera mål tangerar Phil Housleys rekord för en tonårsback.
Nio av Edmontons 13 matcher har gått över 5,5, men de sex senaste mötena hade bara 4,3 mål i snitt.

en.title: Thompson's Sabres chase a third straight win at the start of a Kings homestand
en.deck: Buffalo came back from 3-1 down to beat Anaheim 7-6 behind a Tage Thompson natural hat trick and ends a four-game road trip in Los Angeles. The Kings got their first home win in overtime against Ottawa after almost blowing a 5-1 lead. The market leans Buffalo; the model leans the Kings.
news: Thompson had three goals and two assists in Anaheim, and Buffalo scored its first two road power-play goals of the season.
Sabres out: Alex Lyon, Jiri Kulich (concussion protocol), Konsta Helenius, Matt Grzelcyk, Conor Timmins and Justin Danforth. No starting goalie had been named.

Kings: Brandt Clarke practiced Friday after taking an elbow to the head from Ottawa's Hayden Hodgson. Kevin Fiala and Mats Zuccarello are out. Adrian Kempe and Darcy Kuemper had maintenance days but are expected to play.
Coach Peter Laviolette called the second period against Ottawa the Kings' best of the season and said the third went off the rails.
records: Artemi Panarin's 338th goal on Thursday moved him alone into 10th among Russian-born NHL scorers, and Brian Dumoulin played his 800th game.
Los Angeles led the league with 20 losses beyond regulation last season.
Only 5 of the Kings' 12 games have gone over 5.5 goals, and the last six meetings averaged 5.0.
Both likely starters are struggling: Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen has an .866 save percentage and Kuemper .878.

sv.title: Thompsons Sabres jagar tredje raka segern när Kings inleder en hemmasvit
sv.deck: Buffalo vände 1-3 till 7-6 mot Anaheim med ett rent hattrick av Tage Thompson och avslutar en bortaresa på fyra matcher i Los Angeles. Kings tog sin första hemmaseger på förlängning mot Ottawa efter att nästan ha tappat en 5-1-ledning. Marknaden lutar åt Buffalo, modellen åt Kings.
news: Thompson gjorde tre mål och två assist i Anaheim, och Buffalo gjorde säsongens två första powerplaymål på bortaplan.
Borta för Sabres: Alex Lyon, Jiri Kulich (hjärnskakningsprotokoll), Konsta Helenius, Matt Grzelcyk, Conor Timmins och Justin Danforth. Ingen startmålvakt var utsedd.

Kings: Brandt Clarke tränade i fredags efter en armbåge mot huvudet från Ottawas Hayden Hodgson. Kevin Fiala och Mats Zuccarello är borta. Adrian Kempe och Darcy Kuemper vilade från träningen men väntas spela.
Tränaren Peter Laviolette kallade andra perioden mot Ottawa Kings bästa för säsongen och sa att den tredje spårade ur.
records: Artemi Panarins 338:e mål i torsdags gjorde honom ensam tia bland ryskfödda målskyttar i NHL, och Brian Dumoulin spelade sin 800:e match.
Los Angeles förlorade flest matcher efter full tid i ligan förra säsongen, 20 stycken.
Bara 5 av Kings 12 matcher har gått över 5,5 mål, och de sex senaste mötena hade i snitt 5,0.

en.title: Short-handed Senators need saves in San Jose
en.deck: Ottawa is 1-2-1 and has allowed 20 goals since Linus Ullmark got hurt, and it arrives with only 10 healthy forwards ahead of a back-to-back. The Sharks beat the Senators 6-2 in Ottawa nine days ago. Model and market agree on a small Ottawa edge.
news: Ottawa lost 6-5 in overtime in Los Angeles on Thursday after a four-goal comeback in the third. Jonas Johansson was pulled after allowing four goals on 16 shots, and Samuel Ersson stopped 20 of 22.
Out for Ottawa: Ullmark, Warren Foegele and William Eklund. Andre Burakovsky left Thursday's game early, and the team recalled two forwards. Hayden Hodgson had a disciplinary hearing on Friday.
Captain Thomas Chabot returned on Thursday after missing four games.
San Jose beat Vancouver 3-2: Will Smith scored twice, and Mason Marchment got the winner 11 seconds after the tying goal. Alexander Wennberg and Igor Chernyshov are out.
records: Drake Batherson has a six-game point streak (5 goals, 6 assists). The model flags him and Tim Stützle as running hot.
Stützle's three assists on Thursday were his 10th career game with three or more.
Yaroslav Askarov made 41 saves in the 6-2 win on Oct. 22. Ottawa swept last season's series.
The last seven meetings averaged 7.3 goals.

sv.deck: Ottawa har 1-2-1 och har släppt in 20 mål sedan Linus Ullmark skadades, och laget kommer med bara tio friska forwards inför två matcher på två dagar. Sharks vann med 6-2 i Ottawa för nio dagar sedan. Modellen och marknaden är överens om ett litet övertag för Ottawa.
news: Ottawa förlorade med 6-5 på förlängning i Los Angeles i torsdags efter att ha gjort fyra mål i tredje perioden. Jonas Johansson byttes ut efter fyra insläppta på 16 skott, och Samuel Ersson räddade 20 av 22.

Lagkaptenen Thomas Chabot kom tillbaka i torsdags efter fyra missade matcher.
San Jose slog Vancouver med 3-2: Will Smith gjorde två mål och Mason Marchment avgjorde elva sekunder efter kvitteringen. Alexander Wennberg och Igor Chernyshov är borta.

en.title: Canadiens chase a fifth straight win without Suzuki
en.deck: Montreal has won four in a row with nine different scorers, all without captain Nick Suzuki. Rookie Jacob Fowler, at .942 with two shutouts, could be back in goal against a Penguins team coming off a last-second overtime loss to Utah. Model and market both favour Montreal, the market more firmly.
news: Suzuki (upper body) is expected to miss a fifth straight game. The injury ended his 546-game ironman streak. Ivan Demidov and Sam Montembeault are on injured reserve, and Mike Matheson is day-to-day.
Cole Caufield and Alex Newhook each scored twice in Thursday's 5-2 win over Dallas. Caufield leads the team with 8 goals.
Pittsburgh lost 4-3 in overtime to Utah after Logan Cooley tied it with 0.9 seconds left. Ben Kindel had put the Penguins ahead in his return, and Evgeni Malkin was back from illness.
Bryan Rust is out for at least six weeks. Arturs Silovs has started four straight games.
records: Sidney Crosby needs one power-play point to tie Phil Housley for 10th all-time (612).
Fowler was named the NHL's third star of the week and became the youngest goalie to start an outdoor game.
Pittsburgh won the Oct. 3 meeting 6-5 in overtime after Montreal rallied from four goals down. The last ten meetings averaged 6.9 goals.
Montreal's power play ranks 31st at 10.3%. Erik Karlsson leads Pittsburgh with 13 points.
betting: Market: Canadiens 1.66, Penguins 2.28, about 58–42 without the margin. The model has 53–47, warmer on Pittsburgh.

sv.title: Canadiens jagar femte raka segern utan Suzuki
sv.deck: Montreal har vunnit fyra raka med nio olika målskyttar, allt utan lagkaptenen Nick Suzuki. Rookien Jacob Fowler, med 94,2 räddningsprocent och två nollor, kan vara tillbaka i målet mot ett Penguins som kommer från en förlust på förlängning mot Utah efter en kvittering i sista sekunden. Modellen och marknaden har båda Montreal som favorit, marknaden tydligare.
news: Suzuki (överkropp) väntas missa sin femte raka match. Skadan bröt hans svit på 546 raka matcher. Ivan Demidov och Sam Montembeault är skadade, och Mike Matheson är osäker.
Cole Caufield och Alex Newhook gjorde två mål var i torsdagens 5-2 mot Dallas. Caufield leder laget med 8 mål.

Pittsburgh förlorade med 4-3 på förlängning mot Utah efter att Logan Cooley kvitterat med 0,9 sekunder kvar. Ben Kindel hade gett Penguins ledningen i sin comeback, och Evgeni Malkin var tillbaka efter sjukdom.
Bryan Rust är borta i minst sex veckor. Arturs Silovs har startat fyra raka matcher.
records: Sidney Crosby behöver en powerplaypoäng för att tangera Phil Housley på tionde plats genom tiderna (612).
Fowler utsågs till veckans tredje stjärna i NHL och blev den yngsta målvakten att starta en utomhusmatch.
Pittsburgh vann mötet den 3 oktober med 6-5 på förlängning efter att Montreal kommit tillbaka från fyra mål under. De tio senaste mötena hade i snitt 6,9 mål.

en.title: Bowness brings Columbus back to Dallas as the Stars look for answers
en.deck: Rick Bowness, who took Dallas to the 2020 Stanley Cup Final, returns with a Columbus team that has won its last three games against the Stars. Dallas has lost two straight by a combined 10-3 right after a five-game win streak, and coach Glen Gulutzan called its puck play atrocious. The model has Dallas ahead, but by less than the market.
news: Esa Lindell, Radek Faksa and newly signed David Perron, 38, are all close to playing; Gulutzan expects at least one of them in. Kyle Capobianco is out about four weeks.
Columbus lost 3-2 in Carolina on Thursday after trailing 3-0. Before that it won two straight in overtime, its first winning streak of the season.
Bowness said no building is unwinnable and that his team's best hockey is still ahead if it plays a full 60 minutes.
No starting goalie had been confirmed; the site projects Cam Talbot and Jake Oettinger.
records: Mikko Rantanen's 111 points in his first 100 Stars games are the most by any skater since the franchise moved to Dallas, and he has 15 points in 14 career games against Columbus.
Kent Johnson has 7 goals in 11 games, already matching last season's total, and a three-game point streak.
Zach Werenski has no goals in 11 games after scoring 22 last season. The model flags him as due.

en.title: Coronato's Flames head to Denver on the second night of a back-to-back
en.deck: Calgary beat Seattle 6-2 on Friday behind a career-high four points from Matt Coronato, then flies to Denver for the second half of a back-to-back. Colorado has just lost Josh Manson for about eight weeks. The market makes the Avalanche the night's biggest favourite, and the model agrees on the direction but not the size.
news: Devin Cooley is week-to-week after a crease collision in Edmonton. Dustin Wolf made 20 saves on Friday in his first start since Oct. 15, and Calgary had not named a starter for Saturday.
Manson, Colorado's leader in hits, hurt his ankle in Wednesday's 5-2 win over New Jersey. Brett Kulak called it an irreplaceable loss, and Noah Juulsen is expected to play regularly.
Calgary came into Friday off a 4-0 loss in Edmonton, its first shutout loss of the season, which ended a four-game winning streak.
records: Mikael Backlund passed Johnny Gaudreau for fifth on Calgary's all-time points list (610) and is six behind Joe Nieuwendyk.
Coronato's four points were the first four-point game by a Flame since Oct. 12, 2024. Calgary has won five straight at home.
Calgary's shooting plus save percentage (PDO .934) is among the league's lowest, while Colorado's is 1.052, and 9 of the Avalanche's 13 games have gone over 5.5.
The last ten meetings averaged 6.9 goals.
